target: SiroinoSotai_PC; coarse Foot/Toe-weighted vertex bounds are measured, but foot surface contours, footwear clearance, shoe size, and last are unverified.

requiredPatternComponents.reason: Provisional sewn textile upper with visible split-toe construction; seam geometry and opening allowance require 2D review.
Mirror-side upper hypothesis; left/right dimensions and fit remain unverified.

researchTrial.method: Start with the generated four-view concept reference, decompose each shoe upper into explicit 2D panels, then pair exact boundary edges through pinned GarmentCode/PyGarment.
researchTrial.physicalSewingStitch: Per boot, the medial and lateral vamp halves join along a provisional 90 mm web seam and remain open along a 30 mm split-toe edge; each vamp joins a side quarter, quarters close against a heel counter, the collar band attaches in three edge segments and closes its side seam. The instep tongue joins the vamp top edges as a construction hypothesis. Straps and buckles are overlays, not shell seams; sole and midsole are separate geometry.
researchTrial.review: The target FBX provides only a coarse weighted foot envelope (181 mm longitudinal, 67 mm wide, 72 mm high at default shape-key values); the provisional 2D panel shapes are not flattened from its surface. No foot contour, last, size, circumference, ease, strap length, material thickness, or toe clearance is validated. This stage tests only planar panel topology and GarmentCode edge exchange; do not treat it as a fit or manufacturing pattern.

releaseBoundary: Keep WORKING and visualAppearanceReview PENDING until direct appearance evidence and a reviewed 2D footwear construction pass. Do not initialize 3D before the visualAppearanceReview gate passes; fit and license remain separate pending gates.
